messages.content: I need to be in Nashville for a regional meeting Monday at 9:30 a.m., then at our Memphis location Tuesday at 1:30 p.m. Compare flying round trip through Nashville with flying into Nashville and home from Memphis. I want enough detail to choose which version we should build out with the hotel and car.
What dates are these, and about when will the Memphis inspection finish Tuesday? That determines whether the drive back to Nashville is practical.
Monday is November 9 and Tuesday is November 10. The inspection should end around 3:30 p.m., though I would allow until 4:00.

I found two workable nonstop outbound choices from O'Hare. Sunday departs at 6:05 p.m. and reaches Nashville at 7:38 p.m. Monday's first flight departs at 6:00 a.m. and arrives at 7:31 a.m. The Monday option leaves just under two hours before the meeting, before accounting for deplaning and the ride from BNA, so it has little recovery margin if the flight slips.
Keep both in the comparison, but Sunday sounds more sensible. What happens on the return?

For a Nashville round trip, the latest useful nonstop Tuesday leaves BNA at 8:35 p.m. and arrives at ORD at 10:17 p.m. Memphis to BNA is about 3 hours 10 minutes without a significant stop. If the inspection runs to 4:00, you would need to leave immediately and would reach the airport around 7:10, giving roughly 85 minutes before departure. Traffic or a late inspection could erode that quickly.
And if I fly home from Memphis?

The nonstop MEM-ORD option leaves at 6:45 p.m. and arrives at 8:33 p.m. From the restaurant, the airport drive is about 20 minutes. Leaving at 4:15 would put you there near 4:35, so that itinerary has substantially more margin and gets you home about an hour and forty-five minutes earlier.
Give me the airfare totals for all four combinations. Standard economy, and include an assigned seat if the fare offers it.

The Sunday outbound paired with the Nashville return is $318 round trip. Sunday into Nashville and home from Memphis is $412. The Monday outbound lowers those totals to $286 round trip or $380 open-jaw. All four are standard economy and allow seat selection now. The open-jaw adds $94 in either case; a one-way rental may also cost more, which I will check in the complete-trip pricing.
For my seat, take a window when one is available. Which itinerary would you carry forward?

I would carry forward Sunday ORD-BNA at 6:05-7:38 p.m. and Tuesday MEM-ORD at 6:45-8:33 p.m., currently $412. It avoids putting the Monday meeting at the mercy of the first flight, removes the three-hour return drive after the inspection, and gives you comfortable Tuesday airport margin. I will use an available window seat when the itinerary is booked.
Is saving $126 with the Monday round-trip enough to justify the schedule once ground travel is considered?

Probably not. The $286 Monday round-trip is cheapest on airfare, but it combines the tight 7:31 a.m. arrival before a 9:30 meeting with the 3-hour-10-minute drive from Memphis to BNA Tuesday. It may save some rental drop fee, but it creates risk at both appointments and gets you home later. The more relevant comparison is Sunday round-trip at $318 versus Sunday open-jaw at $412: $94 buys the shorter Tuesday evening and removes the return-drive risk.

Use the Sunday evening outbound and the Memphis return as the working itinerary. Don't book flights yet. Price a Sunday and Monday hotel in the right places and a one-way car from Nashville to Memphis, then compare the complete total against the Sunday Nashville round trip.

Understood. The working flight structure is Sunday ORD-BNA 6:05-7:38 p.m. and Tuesday MEM-ORD 6:45-8:33 p.m., with airfare currently $412 and a window seat to be selected if available. For the next comparison I will price Sunday lodging near the Nashville meeting, Monday lodging positioned for the Tuesday Memphis inspection, and a BNA-to-MEM one-way rental. I will compare that complete total with the $318 Sunday Nashville round trip, using the approximately 3-hour-10-minute Memphis-to-BNA drive and the 8:35-10:17 p.m. Tuesday return. Nothing is booked.
